independenceNote: Speed-torque graph from ROBOTIS's own e-Manual.
methodNote: Speed and efficiency read off the e-Manual's N-T graph (about 0.02 N·m reading error). The graph does not print its voltage; the 11.1 V rating is assumed. The reading error is stated for torque only; our reading errors for speed and efficiency are not quantified.
note: The graph ends at 0.84 N·m, a little over half the 1.5 N·m stall figure. Efficiency near stall reads unreliably: the 0.05 at 3 rpm implies less electrical input than the 10 rpm point at lower torque, which is unlikely. We could not re-check the graph, so treat the lowest-speed efficiency as approximate.
